Worst food experience
May 2022
It's just a hole in the wall at 99/103b Vo Van Tan HCMC.
The food is terrible. 
The steak was cold and disgusting, it smelled like it was stored in the fridge for days and then microwaved to serve. The noodles is cold and the shrimp is rubbery and dry.
They served us "Not for sale" products and charged us 1,5$
The place is easy to find and offers free parking spot. Not very hygienic toilet. No wifi. With 20 bucks you can have better food in HCMC with higher quality.

No chicken in a chicken restaurant
Oct 2018 • Family

Further 15 mins later waitress comes back and tells me they have no chicken left...... In an exclusively chicken only restaurant !! Only thing they could serve me was spaghetti which I declined. 
Why couldn’t they have informed me no chicken available before letting me wait for a table!! 
Joke restaurant....will never go near this place again!!!

Adequate
Jun 2016 • Friends
This, in the context of Ho Chi Minh City, is a restaurant meant for teenagers, hence the decoration and the pretty soft price for its location. 
Therefore, don't expect to find good food here; "acceptable" would be a better word for it. 
It's pretty interesting in the sense that you'll have to look for the restaurant like looking for an apartment in a building that you've never been to. That's something new. 
So, yes, recommended if you're already in the neighborhood and looking for a place to have lunch or dinner.
